claims.claim: Lithium Americas Q2 2026 issuer reporting says Thacker Pass remained targeted for late-2027 mechanical completion, had more than 1,600 workers on site with over 2,000 expected by year-end, and had completed off-site power modifications with energization targeted for Q4 2026.

risks.risk: Construction remains exposed to logistics, skilled-labor, inflation and tariff pressures.

unknowns.unknown: A definitive updated capital estimate was still targeted for completion after Q2 and is not established here.

claims.claim: As of June 30, Lithium Americas reported about $1.3 billion total cash and restricted cash including $530.3 million at the Thacker Pass JV, while identifying estimated tariff exposure of $80-$100 million and other cost pressures; this simultaneously strengthens liquidity evidence and sharpens execution-cost risk.

risks.risk: Tariffs, fabrication capacity, logistics and labor inflation can raise remaining project cost above prior assumptions.

unknowns.unknown: Remaining funding sufficiency should be assessed against the forthcoming definitive capital estimate, not inferred from cash alone.
